seen.body: Owner 2026-10-10: 'can we make the phase letter mode for epics the new default?'. A ledger without id_mode gets epic = letters, issue and task = base35-time; qew init writes the table explicitly. Explicit settings (qew's own ledger, foundlings) are unchanged. Letters are not merge-safe for concurrent epic creation on two machines (a loud git conflict, not silent): epics are rare and human-made.
seen.title: Epic letter ids are the default id_mode: epic letters, issue and task base35-time
